headline: Moderna Shares Face Pressure as Cancer Vaccine Expectations Cool
summary: Investor enthusiasm around Moderna's experimental cancer treatment has moderated following high market expectations ahead of Phase 3 clinical trial data.
why: Moderna is a biotechnology firm specializing in messenger RNA (mRNA) therapeutics and vaccines.

impacts.name: Moderna
impacts.why: Cooling sentiment around core pipeline catalysts reduces growth premiums in stock valuation.

why_moved: Elevated expectations around upcoming clinical trial milestones left the stock vulnerable to profit-taking and sentiment pullbacks.
